changes.reason: Preserve the completed handler outcome when quota refund fails, record a separate runtime inspection event and reject missing refund receipts before handler execution. No host or store implementation changes.

kubernetes.reason: Provider-neutral HTTP outcome reconciliation only. The existing Node Host and rate-limit store contract are reused without cluster, storage or shutdown changes.

aws-lambda.reason: Provider-neutral HTTP outcome reconciliation only. Refund is still awaited inside the existing middleware promise; Lambda invocation and flush ownership do not change.

cloudflare.reason: Provider-neutral HTTP outcome reconciliation only. No Workers bindings, isolate capabilities or Node Container support are added; transports-http retains its node/lambda catalog claims.
